# NexusNova Tools

NexusNova Tools is a free browser-utility website at https://nexusnovatools.com/ focused on practical image, PDF, calculator, QR, text, developer and productivity tools.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://nexusnovatools.com/
- Trending tools: https://nexusnovatools.com/trending-tools.html
- Daily tools: https://nexusnovatools.com/tools.html
- Articles: https://nexusnovatools.com/articles.html
- Guides: https://nexusnovatools.com/guides.html
- Developer tools: https://nexusnovatools.com/developer-tools.html
- Methodology: https://nexusnovatools.com/tool-methodology.html
- Editorial policy: https://nexusnovatools.com/editorial-policy.html
- Privacy: https://nexusnovatools.com/privacy.html

## Modern image conversion tools
- HEIC to JPG: https://nexusnovatools.com/heic-to-jpg.html
- WebP to PNG: https://nexusnovatools.com/webp-to-png.html
- WebP to JPG: https://nexusnovatools.com/webp-to-jpg.html
- AVIF to JPG: https://nexusnovatools.com/avif-to-jpg.html
- PNG to JPG: https://nexusnovatools.com/png-to-jpg.html
- JPG to PNG: https://nexusnovatools.com/jpg-to-png.html
- Image compressor: https://nexusnovatools.com/image-compressor.html
- Image resizer: https://nexusnovatools.com/image-resizer.html
